name: Native grasses & sedges
description: The tussock and turf grasses, rushes and sedges that build the steppe sward - coiron (Stipa, Pappostipa), Festuca magellanica, Poa, Agrostis and relatives. Functional group pooling 24 source nodes (18 native, 0 exotic, 6 mixed-origin), recorded by the source at plant-genus resolution; its diet studies treat this layer as the core forage shared by guanaco, huemul, livestock and the rabbit.
